body:
Triage: **`finding`** (held; exit condition recorded below).

- **Classification**: observation-class — a latent packaging hazard nobody hits today (every current consumer imports named exports, so the module is always evaluated; the card is explicit that this is coincidence, not design). The two candidate fixes have opposite semantics (honour the side effect vs eliminate it) and the card itself asks for a maintainer ruling, so it is not queueable as filed.
- **Anchors verified on `origin/main` @ `50fa376`**: `packages/layout/package.json:5` declares `"sideEffects": false`; `packages/layout/src/index.ts:126-130` performs the load-time `registerLayout()` in a try/catch — both live verbatim.
- **Exit conditions (either promotes this card)**: (1) a maintainer picks direction 1 or 2 — then it is an XS mechanical card; (2) any new consumer adopts the side-effect-only import pattern, at which point this stops being dormant and becomes a live defect.
- **Dedup**: repo-scoped `sideEffects` search returns only this card. Related context, not duplicates: #3787 (workaround site, with reasons written at `apps/site/app/components/registerLayoutBlocks.ts`), #3904 (promoted this round — the Playground host gap is a symptom of the same registration model).

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

依据:现状是**清单对打包器撒谎**(声明零副作用、实际靠加载副作用注册),PR3905 已被迫用显式调 registrar 绕行 —— 这是正确性缺陷,不是风格取舍,先修谎言。「删自动注册改显式 API」那个语义相反的方向是破坏性 API 变更,牵动所有消费者,**留给维护者**(需要时另立卡);两步不冲突:清单说真话之后,显式化迁移随时可做。实施带钉:构建产物实测副作用模块不被 tree-shake(以 PR3905 的三宿主之一为探针)。

`pm:queue` 生效。

Release board: `target:v17` applied — class ②, the published `packages/layout` manifest declares `sideEffects: false` while `registerLayout()` is a load-time side effect, so a bundler honouring the declaration can silently drop the registration and leave consumers with a red `Unknown component type` panel on a green build — a package contract that lies once shipped. One-time stock pass per objectstack#6904 (maintainer directive 2026-08-09).
